visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in a black jacket and white bucket hat poses next to a large Doraemon statue in an indoor shopping environment. (2) She sits on an outdoor bench with statues of Shizuka and Nobita in a park-like setting. (3) Close-up of a Doraemon figure, followed by a wide shot of a giant dinosaur statue with Nobita and Doraemon on its back in a pond. (4) Shots of indoor museum exhibits featuring sketches, interactive screens, and crowds of visitors. (5) Outdoor statues of various characters like Korosuke and Dorami are shown in garden areas. (6) A statue of Gian emerges from a rocky 'fountain' hole. (7) The woman walks through a life-sized pink 'Anywhere Door' in a grassy field. (8) In a themed cafe, the woman reacts to a large plate of Doraemon-shaped curry rice and a blue layered drink. (9) A blue themed bus arrives at a street station, showing transportation options. (10) Introduction to 'Doraemon F's Kitchen' with a chef-themed statue and displays of character-themed food and merchandise. (11) Visuals of the 'Doraemon Future Department Store' showing rows of blue plushies and various branded stationery. (12) An outdoor clock tower area called 'Doraemon Time Square' is shown with more character statues and a performance clock.
